items.title: USWING Mojing Junior World Championships conclude in San Diego — 28-player HK squad; best finishes: Stella Yang 7th (G7-8), Doris Sung T12 (G13-14)

HK Close Amateur & Mid-Amateur (weather-shortened): William Tang wins; Jun Tian 2nd
Taichi Kho wins the International Series Morocco
Felicia Hughes wins Girls Overall title at Singapore Junior Golf Championship, Keppel Club
Isaac Timso runner-up in Development Division at Ciputra Golfpreneur Junior World Championship, Jakarta
Hong Kong, China take bronze at 46th Queen Sirikit Cup behind Japan and Korea
Faldo Series Asia Grand Final: Jun Tian T4 and Doris Sung T5 in U16 divisions at Laguna Lang Co
